title: Assimilated Verbs (Al-Fiʿl al-Mithāl)
source: Original instructional lesson authored for this application (syllabus ref: Haywood & Nahmad Ch. 27; Ryding Ch. 22 §22.5)
objectives: Identify assimilated verbs with an initial weak radical و or ي (e.g., وَصَلَ, وَقَفَ, وَجَدَ).
Apply the elision of initial و in Form I imperfects with middle kasrah and in imperatives.
Distinguish Form I elision (يَصِلُ, صِلْ) from Form IV/VIII retention or assimilation.
recallPrompt: From Chapter 22: What happens to initial و in Form VIII (e.g., و-ح-د)?

sections.heading: Initial Weak Radical Wāw or Yāʾ
sections.body: Assimilated verbs (al-mithāl) begin with و or ي. In the past tense they conjugate completely regularly (وَصَلَ, وَصَلْتُ). In the Form I imperfect, however, initial و drops whenever the middle radical takes kasrah—a pattern shared by most common و-initial verbs.

sections.label: Elision of Initial Wāw
sections.summary: When a و-initial Form I verb has kasrah on C2 in the imperfect (يَوْصِلُ → يَصِلُ), the و drops in all imperfect persons (أَصِلُ, تَصِلُ, يَصِلُ, نَصِلُ) AND in the imperative (صِلْ, صِلِي, صِلُوا—with no prosthetic alif needed!).

sections.heading: Assimilated Verb Examples
rows: to place (drops و even with fatḥah)

sections.irab: وَجَدَ: فِعْلٌ مَاضٍ (مِثَالٌ وَاوِيٌّ) | المُسَافِرُ: فَاعِلٌ مَرْفُوعٌ | الطَّرِيقَ: مَفْعُولٌ بِهِ مَنْصُوبٌ
sections.notes: In the past tense, و remains visible (وَجَدَ); in the imperfect (يَجِدُ) and imperative (جِدْ), the و drops.

sections.heading: Maṣdar Clue
sections.body: Many assimilated verbs form a feminine maṣdar ending in ة after dropping و: وَصَلَ → صِلَةٌ ('connection'), وَهَبَ → هِبَةٌ ('gift').
